notes: Pupate (PUPATE) on Ethereum mainnet: a tax on every trade in the launch pool buys Identity MD seats, puts them to work in the IMD swarm, lists them for resale, and burns PUPATE with the proceeds. This manifest deploys PupateToken and PupateHook only. TOKEN: plain ERC-20, zero-argument constructor, 1,000,000,000 PUPATE at 18 decimals minted once to its deployer; no owner, mint, pause, tax, transfer limit or blacklist; burn and burnFrom only reduce supply. HOOK: constructor ($poolManager, sink, owner). The sink is the vault Cocoon at 0xc4e514e60565a2c04bd657f18bb34b503d6c299d; the owner is an OpenZeppelin TimelockController with a 48-hour delay at 0x8be826082c0fbaec485048aa26ef42ac147898ec; both are deployed before this launch. Permissions afterInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta, flags 0x18CC, which the constructor validates against the hook's own address, so the hook needs a mined CREATE2 salt. The first native-ETH pool initialised on the hook is its launch pool for good. TAX: on the ETH side of every swap in the launch pool, beside the pool's LP fee. Sells pay 6%. Buys pay 99% when the pool opens, falling one percentage point a minute to 6% after about 93 minutes. Swaps whose sender is the sink are not taxed. The tax is collected inside the swap as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager; swap callbacks call only the PoolManager and move no ETH. A taxed swap that names its ETH amount and cannot fill in full reverts (PartialFill). flush() is permissionless: it redeems the claims and sends the hook's whole ETH balance to Cocoon.depositTax. The owner can only lower the standing tax and transfer ownership; nothing can raise the tax, change the sink or change the launch pool. LIQUIDITY: liquidity can be added only to the launch pool and only in the transaction that initialises it (an EIP-1153 mark set in afterInitialize), so deploy, initialise and seed in one transaction. Later transactions cannot add, in the same block as well; removal and fee collection are never gated. Known residual, kept on purpose and pinned by a test: the mark names no account, so code that gets control later inside the opening transaction could add too; the launch factory calls only the PoolManager, the token and its own registry there. POOL: currency0 native ETH, currency1 PUPATE, LP fee 12500, tick spacing 60. initialPrice is sqrtPriceX96 10^4 * 2^96 (tick 184216): 1 ETH = 100,000,000 PUPATE, the policy's 10 ETH valuation of the supply, the value test/fork/LaunchFactory.fork.t.sol opens at through the real launch factory. VAULT: Cocoon and FloorFeed are in src/ for review and are not deployed by this manifest. Cocoon splits each deposit 85% to the strategy (seat pot and burn pot), 10% to the developer and 5% to buy and burn IMD. After the launch, script/PostLaunch.s.sol wires the vault to the new pool, moves the launch wallet's 5% of supply into a 12-month linear vesting contract, pins the oracle question, and transfers Cocoon and FloorFeed to the timelock. HISTORY: launch #1400 of this project was parked for one finding in the vault deployed at the time: skim() could run from inside takeAuction's lot transfer and book the taker's unrefunded excess into the burn pot. It is fixed (skim and depositTax hold the reentrancy lock, and the excess is refunded before the lot token is called), and the vault named above is a new deployment of the fixed source. The hook and the token are unchanged. That audit's advisories and what was done about each are in docs/REVIEW.md. Reviews are logged in docs/REVIEW.md; no audit or security claim is made. Nothing here is a statement about returns.
